snippet.title: Beneath - Official Launch Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Check out the launch trailer for Beneath, which will be released on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC on October 27, 2025. Beneath is a Lovecraft-inspired survival FPS that tells a 10+ hour single-player story that’s built for “both veteran gamers and those seeking a challenging old school experience."

#ign #gaming
